name: Yamada Bee Farm (山田養蜂場)
description: One of Japan's best-known honey companies; sells Canadian clover honey (クローバー蜂蜜 カナダ産) under its own brand, in 100 g to 1 kg sizes, and has featured Alberta clover beekeeping in its 'Bee World' series.
contact: Contact form on the company website

name: Mizutani Bee Farm (水谷養蜂園)
description: Mie-based honey company that sells Canadian white clover honey (カナダ産結晶蜜) alongside domestic honey.
contact: Contact details on the company website

name: Queen Bee Garden (クインビーガーデン)
description: Honey and maple syrup specialist that sells Canadian pure clover honey in retail and 2.5 kg foodservice formats through wholesalers.
contact: Contact details on the company website

name: D. Schumacher GmbH & Co. KG
description: Bremen honey broker (founded 2017 by a veteran of Germany's large honey importers) that matches honey producers worldwide with buyers; member of the German Honey Association.

name: Honig-Verband e.V. (German Honey Association)
description: Association of German honey importers and packers. Its member list is the standard starting point for finding German buyers of bulk honey.
contact: Member list on the association website

name: Scarletts Scotland
description: Scottish company that describes itself as one of the UK's leading honey packers.
contact: Contact details on the company website

name: The Honey Association (British Honey Importers and Packers Association)
description: The UK trade body for honey importers and packers; the route to the companies that buy imported honey for UK retail.

name: Canadian Honey Council
description: National body for Canada's beekeepers; publishes an exporters catalogue and tracks tariff and market-access changes for honey.

name: Pax8
description: Cloud software distributor whose marketplace sells vendors' SaaS through thousands of managed service providers. Has a vendor onboarding program.
contact: Vendor application on the Pax8 website

name: Dicker Data
description: ASX-listed Australian IT distributor that signs software vendors for distribution across Australia and New Zealand (e.g. CrowdStrike, One Identity).
contact: Vendor enquiries via the company website

name: Giacom (Cloud Market)
description: UK cloud marketplace that supplies software to more than 6,000 local technology providers. Accepts new vendors.

name: ALSO Cloud Marketplace
description: European IT distributor ALSO Holding's cloud marketplace, which resells SaaS through its reseller network across Europe, including Germany.
contact: Vendor enquiries via the ALSO website

name: CANCOM Cloud Marketplace (ISV partners)
description: German IT services company whose cloud marketplace onboards ISV partners' SaaS applications.

name: Canadian Trade Commissioner Service
description: Government of Canada trade commissioners in every one of these markets help Canadian businesses find vetted local partners, at no charge.
contact: Find a trade commissioner for the target market
